```{r}
merged_df <-readRDS(file ="RCSI_Taxonomy_clin_prot_merged_df.rds")
prognostic_groups <- readRDS( file = "profile_group_assignments_fn.rds")
```

```{r}
baseline_mean_cols <- grep(
  "^baseline.*mean",
  colnames(merged_df),
  value = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

cancer_cols  <- grep("_mean_NonImmuneEpithelium$", colnames(merged_df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
stroma_cols  <- grep("_mean_NonImmuneStroma$",     colnames(merged_df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
cytT_cols    <- grep("_mean_cytT$",                colnames(merged_df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
helperT_cols <- grep("_mean_helperT$",             colnames(merged_df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
regT_cols    <- grep("_mean_regT$",                colnames(merged_df), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

# Check
cat("Cancer:",  length(cancer_cols),  "\n"); writeLines(cancer_cols)
cat("Stroma:",  length(stroma_cols),  "\n"); writeLines(stroma_cols)
cat("CytT:",    length(cytT_cols),    "\n"); writeLines(cytT_cols)
cat("HelperT:", length(helperT_cols), "\n"); writeLines(helperT_cols)
cat("RegT:",    length(regT_cols),    "\n"); writeLines(regT_cols)

```
```{r}

###run limma on cell types by prognostic group
# Create a new df with prognostic groups merged in — original merged_df untouched
analysis_df <- merge(merged_df, prognostic_groups, by = "patient_id", all.x = TRUE)

# Confirm
table(analysis_df$profile_group, useNA = "always")

all_cell_cols <- c(cancer_cols, stroma_cols, cytT_cols, helperT_cols, regT_cols)

# ── Build expression matrix ──────────────────────────────────────
expr_mat <- t(as.matrix(analysis_df[, all_cell_cols]))
colnames(expr_mat) <- analysis_df$patient_id

# ── Design matrix ────────────────────────────────────────────────
profile_group <- factor(analysis_df$profile_group, levels = c("Good", "Poor"))
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + profile_group)
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

# ── Contrast ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
contrast_mat <- makeContrasts(
  PoorvsGood = profile_groupPoor - profile_groupGood,
  levels = design
)

# ── Fit limma ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fit  <- lmFit(expr_mat, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_mat)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

# ── Extract results ──────────────────────────────────────────────
results_limma <- topTable(fit2,
                          coef          = "PoorvsGood",
                          number        = Inf,
                          adjust.method = "BH",
                          sort.by       = "P")

# ── Annotate by cell type ────────────────────────────────────────
results_limma$cell_type <- dplyr::case_when(
  rownames(results_limma) %in% cancer_cols  ~ "NonImmuneEpithelium",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% stroma_cols  ~ "NonImmuneStroma",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% cytT_cols    ~ "CytotoxicT",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% helperT_cols ~ "HelperT",
  rownames(results_limma) %in% regT_cols    ~ "RegulatoryT",
  TRUE ~ "Other"
)

# ── Save ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write.csv(results_limma, "limma_differential_abundance_PoorvsGood_fn.csv")
saveRDS(results_limma,   "limma_differential_abundance_PoorvsGood_fn.rds")

# ── Quick look ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
head(results_limma, 20)
```
```{r}
options(scipen = 999)
# ── 5 tables: UP IN POOR ─────────────────────────────────────────
for (ct in cell_types) {
  tbl <- results_limma %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct, logFC > 0.15) %>%
    arrange(desc(logFC)) %>%
    select(feature, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
  
  cat("\n====== UP IN POOR |", ct, "| n =", nrow(tbl), "======\n")
  print(tbl, n = Inf)
}

# ── 5 tables: UP IN GOOD ─────────────────────────────────────────
for (ct in cell_types) {
  tbl <- results_limma %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct, logFC < -0.15) %>%
    arrange(logFC) %>%
    select(feature, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val)
  
  cat("\n====== UP IN GOOD |", ct, "| n =", nrow(tbl), "======\n")
print(tbl, n = Inf)
}
```
